nodes.label: When Should LLMs Be Less Specific? Selective Abstraction for Reliable Long-Form Text Generation
nodes.author: Shani Goren, Ido Galil, Ran El-Yaniv
nodes.rationale: Introduces Selective Abstraction framework enabling LLMs to trade specificity for reliability in long-form generation by selectively reducing detail of uncertain content at claim level.

nodes.label: Selective Abstraction (SA) Framework
nodes.rationale: General framework formalizing trade-off between specificity and reliability through selective risk and coverage metrics; enables LLMs to reduce information in uncertain parts while retaining valuable content.

nodes.label: Atom-wise Selective Abstraction
nodes.rationale: Claim-level instantiation of SA that decomposes responses into atomic claims and replaces uncertain atoms with higher-confidence, less specific abstractions; core technical contribution.

nodes.label: Atomic Claims
nodes.rationale: Short, self-contained statements each expressing a single fact; fundamental unit for atom-wise SA enabling fine-grained uncertainty handling.

nodes.label: Atomization Stage (SA Pipeline)
nodes.rationale: Decomposes generated text into atomic claims using few-shot prompting; enables subsequent confidence scoring and abstraction.

nodes.label: Abstraction Stage (SA Pipeline)
nodes.rationale: Core stage consisting of: (1) atom confidence elicitation, (2) abstraction sequence generation with confidence scoring, (3) selection of most specific abstraction exceeding threshold.

nodes.label: Reconstruction Stage (SA Pipeline)
nodes.rationale: Final stage reconstructing selected abstractions into coherent text, yielding revised response preserving high-confidence content while abstracting uncertain details.

nodes.label: Verbalized Confidence Scoring
nodes.rationale: Primary confidence function where LLM explicitly reports confidence verbally; outperforms logprob-based and P(True) alternatives with AUROC 0.74 vs 0.69-0.35.

nodes.label: Risk-Coverage Trade-off
nodes.rationale: Core evaluation framework: risk quantifies factual correctness, coverage measures retained information; varying confidence threshold traces RC curve.

nodes.label: Area Under Risk-Coverage Curve (AURC)
nodes.rationale: Summary metric for RC curves; lower AURC indicates better risk-coverage trade-off; atom-wise SA achieves 17.43% average improvement over redaction on FactScore.

nodes.label: FactScore Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Long-form factuality benchmark with biography prompts; used for evaluating SA with 36 prompts; atom-wise SA achieves up to 27.73% AURC improvement.

nodes.label: LongFact-Objects Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Open-ended factual QA benchmark across 38 subject areas; used for SA evaluation with 76 prompts; atom-wise SA achieves 13.77% average AURC improvement.

nodes.label: Information-Theoretic Coverage Measure
nodes.rationale: Measures information content of claims via entropy reduction: I(c) = 1 - log(|Ec|)/log(|E|); quantifies how much a claim narrows compatible entity set.

nodes.label: Wikidata Knowledge Base
nodes.rationale: Used to estimate entity set sizes for information measure; enables automatic coverage computation at scale via SPARQL queries.

nodes.label: Agentic Fact-Checking Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Verifies abstractions against Wikipedia using free API and gpt-oss-120b; achieves F1 0.93 on manual validation; enables large-scale risk evaluation.

nodes.label: Risk-Guided Threshold Selection Algorithm
nodes.rationale: Inspired by split conformal prediction; selects confidence threshold to meet user-defined target risk with high probability; empirically validated on FactScore and LongFact.

nodes.label: Selective Redaction Baseline
nodes.rationale: Standard baseline removing all atoms below confidence threshold without abstraction; atom-wise SA outperforms by 17.43% AURC on FactScore.

nodes.label: Inline Abstraction Baseline
nodes.rationale: Adaptation of aggregation prompt from Yona et al.; reduces granularity during generation; atom-wise SA achieves 10.65% lower risk at matched coverage.

nodes.label: Self-Revision Baseline
nodes.rationale: Post-hoc refinement instructing model to replace uncertain claims with less specific versions; atom-wise SA achieves 12.45% lower risk at matched coverage.
